title: Azerbaijan to raise renewables share to 34% by end-2027
excerpt:
QAZAQ GREEN. Azerbaijan plans to increase the share of renewable energy sources (RES) in its total installed power generation capacity to 34% by the end of 2027, Deputy Energy Minister Elnur Soltanov said during a panel discussion at the Baku Climate Action Week 2026 (BCAW 2026), according to Report .az.

The share of renewables currently stands at 21%. According to Soltanov, renewable energy generation in Azerbaijan is expected to nearly double this year compared with 2025.

title: 11.09.2026 Former German nuclear plant site to host 254 MW battery storage facility
excerpt:
QAZAQ GREEN. Vattenfall has taken the final investment decision to build a large battery energy storage system at its site in Brunsbüttel, Germany. With a power output of 254 MW and storage capacity of around 1,000 MWh, the facility will be one of Germany’s largest battery storage projects and Vattenfall’s largest battery project to date.

The facility will be built on the site of the former Brunsbüttel nuclear power plant, which is currently being decommissioned. The battery is scheduled to become operational and connect to the 50Hertz transmission grid at 380 kV by the end of 2028.

title: Masdar and Luxcara explore more than €5bn in German energy investments
excerpt:
QAZAQ GREEN. Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC (Masdar) and German asset manager Luxcara have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to explore a strategic partnership focused on battery energy storage and offshore wind projects in Germany and other European markets.

Under the agreement, the companies will explore potential joint investments of more than €5 billion in battery storage, offshore wind and potentially other technologies.

title: 15.09.2026 Portuguese scientists find deep geological formations could store enough energy to power a city
excerpt:
QAZAQ GREEN. Deep porous rock formations could be used to store renewable electricity for extended periods, according to researchers from NOVA FCT and the University of Lisbon who assessed the potential of compressed air energy storage in porous media (CAES-PM).

The study, published in the journal Geoenergy, is the first to combine geological and thermodynamic criteria to assess the energy storage potential of underground reservoirs.

title: 15.09.2026 Japan to add 50MW/196MWh battery energy storage system
excerpt:
QAZAQ GREEN. Japan-based renewable energy platform Nozomi Energy has reached financial close on the Nozu Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), a 50MW/196MWh project in Oita Prefecture.

The project is located in Nishihata, Usuki City, and was awarded under Japan's FY2023 Long-Term Decarbonisation Auction (LTDA). It is eligible for 20 years of capacity payments linked to the Consumer Price Index.

title: Masdar plans to commission a 1 GW wind farm in Kazakhstan in 2029

title: Taiwan’s Formosa 6 offshore wind farm secures corporate power deal

title: 1 GW wind power project with energy storage discussed by Kazakhstan and SPIC
excerpt:
QAZAQ GREEN. Kazakhstan’s Ministry of Energy and the management of Chinese energy corporation State Power Investment Corporation (SPIC) discussed the progress of a 1 GW wind power project in the Pavlodar region, Energy Ministry reports.

The Pavlodar Green Energy project is being developed by SPIC jointly with Pavlodar Green Energy LLP near the city of Ekibastuz. The project involves $1.2 billion in direct foreign investment, with the wind farm scheduled to be commissioned in 2029.

The project is being developed with investment from Chinese company Sichuan Energy International Group Co., Ltd.
